map.甲烷 1 t、100 年 GWP=28：CO₂e=28 t。若某过程排 0.5: Methane 1 t, 100-year GWP=28: CO₂e=28 t. If a process emits 0.5 t CH₄, that is equivalent to 14 t CO₂e. Tip: the GWP value (20/100-year) makes a large difference, so the basis must be stated.
map.全球增温潜势，衡量单位质量气体相对 CO₂ 的增温能力；CH₄、N₂O 远高于: Global Warming Potential, measuring the warming capacity of a unit mass of gas relative to CO₂; CH₄ and N₂O are far higher than CO₂ and are used to convert to CO₂e.

map.温室气体排放换算（CO₂当量）。能源电力工具，帮助计算能耗与电力参数。: Greenhouse Gas Emission Conversion (CO₂ Equivalent). An energy and power tool that helps compute energy consumption and power parameters.
map.温室气体当量换算（GWP 系数比）：结果 = 质量 × from系数 ÷ to系: Greenhouse-gas equivalent conversion (GWP coefficient ratio): result = mass × from coefficient ÷ to coefficient (rounded to 12 significant digits), where the unit coefficients are the GWP values (CO₂ = 1, CH₄ = 28, N₂O = 265, SF₆ = 22800, 100-year basis); related values: reverse conversion = mass × to coefficient ÷ from coefficient, coefficient ratio = from coefficient ÷ to coefficient. Validation: no strict checks; empty values fall back to 0, and non-finite results are handled by the renderer. Criteria: no fixed grading; semantically it is CO₂ equivalent = mass × GWP normalized to the baseline.
